subject: Onboarding/offboarding verification samples for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Jillian Ho <jillian.ho@stellarsys.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: security@stellarsys.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding/offboarding verification samples for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Logan,

Stellarsys is preparing for our SOC 2 assessment and our auditor has asked for a sample set of onboarding/offboarding artifacts from Redwood to validate personnel controls. Specifically they want:

- Redacted background check results (sample of 3)
- Training completion certificates for security awareness and data handling (samples)
- A deprovisioning runbook excerpt and logs showing recent account removals (last 90 days)
- Confirmation of retention/PII redaction policy and access to an example signed consent form

Can you provide redacted samples and an estimated delivery date? Auditor would like materials by 2027-11-10. We can accept a secure Drive upload or an encrypted email.

We are okay with hashed identifiers in samples instead of employee names. Please confirm whether contractor/non-employee accounts are included in the deprovisioning logs.

Thanks,
Jillian
Jillian Ho
Security Manager, Stellarsys
security@stellarsys.com

Attachment: auditor_request_Doc-4583.pdf (pdf)
From: logan.wright@redwood.com <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jillian Ho <jillian.ho@stellarsys.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding/offboarding verification samples for SOC 2 evidence

Thanks for the detail, Jillian.

I can take point on coordinating this. Looping in Vivek (security) and Stephanie (HR) to assemble the redacted samples and the deprovisioning artifacts. Our plan:

1) Provide redacted background check samples (names removed, hashed IDs)
2) Training completion artifacts (PDF certificates and a summary CSV)
3) Deprovisioning runbook excerpt + recent removal log (we will scope to user types you specify; default = all employee accounts)
4) Retention and PII-redaction statement and a sample consent form (redacted)

Can you confirm whether you need contractor accounts included? Also confirm preferred delivery channel (secure Drive link OK?). We will aim to get an initial bundle by 2027-11-05 and the full set by 2027-11-09.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 3, 2027 at 10:05 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the detail, Jillian.

Hi all — Vivek from Security. Quick summary of evidence we can provide today and notes on redaction and scope: 

- Background checks: we will provide 3 redacted PDFs for employees (no SSNs, names replaced with hashed employee IDs). Attach: background_checks_redacted_sample.pdf (contains 3 samples, redaction stamps).
- Training certificates: we’ll provide individual PDF certificates plus training_summary_2027Q3.csv. Certificates include completion date and course IDs only. Attach: training_completion_samples.zip (contains 5 exemplar certs).
- Deprovisioning: include runbook excerpt (deprovisioning_runbook_excerpt.pdf) and an exported deprovisioning log for Sept–Nov 2027 (sso_deprovisioning_log_202709-202711.csv). Logs will show hashed IDs, account type (employee/contractor/service), timestamp, and action.
- Retention and redaction: our standard practice is to retain background check documents for 7 years and to present redacted copies for third parties; PII is removed unless auditor has a signed NDA and explicit need. We can provide a one-paragraph retention excerpt.

Notes: contractor accounts are included in deprovisioning exports if they were managed in our identity provider (Okta). If the contractor was external (non-managed), logs may not exist.

I have attached the runbook excerpt and redaction guidance; Stephanie will confirm HR-side forms (consent).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Thanks — that is very helpful. A couple quick clarifications before our auditor consumes the samples:

1) Can you include a hashed-to-internal-id mapping file (hash prefix only) so we can correlate certificates to the deprovisioning logs without seeing names?
2) Please confirm whether contractor accounts managed in Okta are included by default (sounds like yes) and whether temporary vendor accounts are excluded.

If you can drop the mapping file and a short confirmation note about contractors by EOD today, that would keep us on track for our 11/10 audit intake. We will retrieve samples from the Drive link you provided.

—Jillian

Files added: onboarding_roster_2027Q3.csv (hashed_id column), mapping_prefixes.txt (hash prefixes only), background_checks_redacted_sample.pdf, training_completion_samples.zip, deprovisioning_runbook_excerpt.pdf, sso_deprovisioning_log_202709-202711.csv.
